answer: A work-bound stake gate resists Sybil clones: each new agent must prove useful output before voting, and its weight is escrowed reputation only peers can slash. Clones are cheap to mint but expensive to earn, so a thousand puppet agents each need a beacon of verified work. Sybil farmers therefore pay the full runtime and grader cost per identity with no pooled discount. Reputation spreads like a nebula, dense only where honest labour accumulated. A single vine of trust ties every new node to a vouching chain, and a broken link burns the whole cluster.
